notes.title: BattleCap Major Update: Performance Optimization & CPU Players
notes.content:
Dear Captains,

Thank you for your continued support and passion for BattleCap! We are always committed to delivering a smoother and richer gaming experience while steadily progressing on multi-platform porting. Today, we are thrilled to bring you a major version update, focusing on performance optimization and introducing thoughtful features like CPU players!

[h1]✨ Key Update Highlights ✨[/h1]
We understand that every player's experience matters, especially for captains using different hardware setups. This update aims to ensure more players can enjoy the game without performance concerns.

🚀 Performance Optimization
Reduced CPU usage significantly, allowing smoother gameplay even on lower-end systems.

Optimized rendering pipeline, fixing frame rate fluctuations in certain scenes for stable combat visuals.

Added full graphics settings, letting players fine-tune performance to reduce hardware strain.

🤖 Introducing CPU Players
Now, you can engage in intense PvP battles with AI opponents! When human players are scarce, AI will seamlessly fill the battlefield to keep the action going.


🚀 Update now and dive back into battle for a smoother, more thrilling experience!

If you encounter any issues after updating, feel free to reach out via our official community or support team. We’ll keep refining the game based on your feedback. Once again, thank you for your support—more exciting content is on the way!

— The BattleCap Development Team

notes.title: Build big ships, fight naval battles! "BattleCap" is on sale with spe
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45025964/2dfb401081f402410d49e91565c9b9c4a0c53d29.png[/img]
It's hard to find a game where I can operate such a "squishy" vessel—while other people's warships dodge torpedoes by turning out, our warships dodge torpedoes by using centrifugal force to "wag" their tails.

Experience a completely different kind of naval battle today: "BattleCap," now joyfully released on December 31st! It's priced at $9.59 USD for the initial launch!!!

Left joystick/WASD to move, right trigger/mouse to shoot. There you go, you can now easily maneuver the warship!
The hull structure is formed by gum sticking together. Pick up your bottle caps and stick together a ship that feels most comfortable to use.

Game Features:
Twisted and Transforming Warships: Warships shaped like bottle caps, held together by bubble gum. Can you handle a ship that can deform at any time and occasionally falls apart?

Beverage Party, Easy to Get Started: This is the tutorial: Left joystick/WASD to move, right trigger/mouse to shoot. There you go, you can now easily maneuver the warship! Discover other winning details slowly within the game.

Fast-Paced Party Competition: A 3-minute match, with three matches to win in the PVP mode, allowing you to experience the thrill of speed in intense duels. After each match, why not raise a toast to celebrate, perfectly blending the game with the party atmosphere.

Cooperatively Facing Sea Monsters: Defend towers on half a MOBA map, pair up warships, and develop quickly. Resist the invasion of sea monsters with friends and enjoy the fun of cooperation.

notes.title: “BattleCap” has been elected into CUSGA first round. Check our new PV!
notes.content:
经过了8个月的鏖战，是时候让瓶盖战舰一点一点地和大家见面了。
PV已经更新至steam商店页，B站也有同步链接，欢迎支持。我们还在继续努力，将“瓶盖拼战舰”这个有趣的玩法概念以最好的形式展现给大家！

After 8 months of intense development, it's time to gradually reveal the BattleCap to everyone.
The PV has been updated to the Steam store page, and there is also a synchronized link on Bilibili, welcome to support us. We are still working hard to present the fun gameplay concept of "Bottle Cap Battleship" in the best possible form!

[url=https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1BRKoeMExG/?vd_source=7c41d357001ef247c813fc7077fa4866]B站：把究级手做进海战？交大复旦er的独立游戏PV首曝[/url]

《瓶盖战舰》是一款1~4人游玩的聚会海战射击游戏，包含PVP对战与PVE合作玩法。驾驶你的瓶盖战舰，吸附、合成、变形、开炮……一起来射个痛快！添加愿望单支持我们！

"BattleCap" is a party naval battle shooting game for 1 to 4 players, including PVP and PVE cooperative gameplay. Drive your bottle cap battleship, adsorb, synthesize, transform, and fire... Let's have a great time shooting together! Add it to your wish list to support us!


机壳杏仁是一家以交大/复旦的杰出独立游戏创作者为核心的游戏初创公司，致力于超新锐文化和创新性玩法。

MechAlmond is a game startup company with outstanding independent game creators from Shanghai Jiaotong University/Fudan University at its core, committed to edge-cutting culture and innovative gameplay.
